method: TI NE555 astable equations; arithmetic independently evaluated with Python Decimal

indicator.on_state: U1 output low; current flows from VCC through R3 and D1 into pin 3

limitations: Timing estimates use nominal equations and component tolerance bounds; no SPICE or physical measurement has been performed.
LED voltage is specified at 10mA; actual low-current current/brightness is not guaranteed by that test point.
555 output low voltage, supply ripple, capacitor leakage, temperature, and component aging are not included in the timing/current estimates.

The supply bypass capacitor is absent because the current compiler semantic profile cannot own that new support occurrence; its failed attempt is retained in fixtures/pivot/runs/reference_555_led_flasher_v1_run2.failed.
